newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens shares set record above 100 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Siemens shares set record above 100 dmk.

text.p: Shares in German electronics and engineering giant Siemens AG surged to record highs of more than 100 marks ($58.67) on Friday after a presentation in London sparked several large buy orders, dealers said.

The shares hit an intraday high of 101.10 marks before settling to close at 100.90 marks, up 2.50 marks or 2.5 percent on a day which saw the DAX index edge up just 0.3 percent to close at 3,562.41 points.
Dealers said the share's break above 100 marks had also triggered technically-driven buy orders.
Several large orders came in from foreign buyers, Frankfurt dealers said.
